Wix vs WordPress vs custom-coded?
Think about it this way:
Wix: simplicity and convenience.
WordPress: flexibility with a huge ecosystem.
Custom: maximum control over functionality, architecture and code.
None is automatically "the best."
The right choice depends on your budget, technical requirements, expected growth, maintenance needs and how much control you want.
Choose the platform based on the business.
Not because everyone else uses it.
